ct.dataset: Medical Segmentation Decathlon Task03 Liver / LiTS

mri.comparisonTarget: Union of labels 1, 2, 3; tumor-associated region, not just enhancing tumor.

method: One volume per modality. Three reference-positive and one reference-negative axial slice per case, selected before model inference. Native integer voxel values and affine preserved in NRRD, no resampling. CT W400/L50; MRI W5574/L2787. Only image pixels and normal image context sent to the existing app model; no reference masks or diagnostic labels supplied. Unknown training-set overlap: this is a labeled-case demonstration, not an independent generalization benchmark. A negative mask slice means no annotated target, not absence of every possible disease.
